description: Elevated nighttime photograph of a tree-lined London street with queued car traffic, streetlights, pedestrians on the left pavement, and a traffic signal at right; a lit clock tower consistent with Elizabeth Tower (Big Ben) is visible in the distance, suggesting a view along Victoria Embankment. The image is letterboxed inside a large black frame, consistent with a phone screenshot of a photo. The Q-post filename NSA_Traf_CAM_LONDON2847.png implies it is an NSA traffic-camera capture, a claim the image itself does not verify.
flags: Location inferred from tower silhouette and filename, not confirmed
Filename claim of NSA traffic camera origin is unverified

description: Screenshot of a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet dated Oct 15, showing roughly 36K retweets and 86K likes. In it Donald Trump claims Hillary Clinton should have been prosecuted and jailed and characterizes the election she is running in as looking rigged. The tweet dates to the 2016 campaign; its assertions are the tweet’s claims, not established facts.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump · Oct 15. 36K. 86K. Hillary Clinton should have been prosecuted and should be in jail. Instead she is running for president in what looks like a rigged election
flags: Tweet’s claims about prosecution and a rigged election are assertions, not established facts

description: Screenshot of a Liddle Kidz Foundation webpage headed ‘Meet the Liddle Kidz™ Global Ambassadors | India 2017’, showing a circular ‘Liddle Kidz Foundation Global Ambassador India 2017’ badge with a lotus emblem. A sidebar titled ‘Our Sponsors + Supporters’ lists logos for the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, Microsoft, Google, and EPIC (‘100% grass fed protein’). A red arrow has been added pointing at the small emblem above the EPIC wordmark, implying it is significant; the screenshot circulated with QAnon claims insinuating the charity’s branding contained coded symbols, a claim the image does not substantiate.
text: Meet the Liddle Kidz™ Global Ambassadors | India 2017. Our Sponsors + Supporters. BILL & MELINDA GATES foundation. Microsoft. Google. LIDDLE KIDZ FOUNDATION. Global. AMBASSADOR. INDIA 2017. EPIC. 100% GRASS FED PROTEIN
flags: Red arrow annotation insinuates hidden meaning in the EPIC logo; the insinuated symbolism claim is unverified
Conspiracy claims about the Liddle Kidz Foundation are unsubstantiated

description: Very large stitched screenshot compiling several dozen anonymous 4chan /pol/ posts from the early-November 2017 ‘Bread Crumbs - Q Clearance Patriot’ threads, including many early Q drops (some under tripcode !ITPb.qbhqo) interleaved with anon replies. The posts pose long Socratic question chains about military intelligence, Q clearance, Saudi Arabia, Huma Abedin, the Podestas, John McCain, the Muslim Brotherhood, and alleged coming arrests, with recurring signature phrases such as ‘Alice & Wonderland’ and ‘4,10,20’. All content is the posters’ claims; the sheer number of posts makes full transcription impractical.
text: Bread Crumbs - Q Clearance Patriot. Q Clearance Patriot. Military Intelligence. What is ‘State Secrets’ and how upheld in the SC? Why is this relevant? What is Q Clearance? Who is the Queen of England? Follow Huma. Where is BO TODAY??? What is a spider web? My fellow Americans, the Storm is upon us. God bless. Alice & Wonderland. 4,10,20. ONE NATION UNDER GOD. LET JUSTICE BE SERVED. Snow White. Godfather III. HUMA. WHERE WAS BO YESTERDAY?
flags: FLAGGED FOR MANUAL REVIEW: stitched compilation of dozens of forum posts far too large to transcribe; summary and key phrases only
All post content consists of unverified anonymous claims and conspiracy assertions

description: Screenshot of a Q drop dated Feb 18 2018, posted under tripcode !UW.yye1fxo, with ‘PROJECT DEEPDREAM’ highlighted in blue. The drop addresses @Snowden (Edward Snowden), claims he is not in Russia and is ‘now a liability’ helping @Jack, references ‘ES’ and John Perry Barlow, cites John 3:16, and declares ‘the day of reckoning is upon us.’ All statements are the drop’s claims; the filename snwdn.png also points to Snowden.
text: Feb 18 2018 20:41:03. !UW.yye1fxo. Q. 104→. @SNOWDEN. WHERE ARE YOU? NOT RUSSIA. [EYES ON]. YOU ARE NOW A LIABILITY. HELPING @JACK? PROJECT DEEPDREAMv2[A]. WE WILL NEVER FORGET. ES FAILED. WHERE IS ES? JOHN PERRY BARLOW. DEFINE THE END? THE DAY OF RECKONING IS UPON US. JOHN 3:16. Q
flags: Drop’s claims about Snowden’s location and activities are unverified
‘@Jack’ and ‘ES’ are unnamed in the image; common readings (Jack Dorsey, Eric Schmidt) are interpretations, not stated
